local_regression.platform: Windows x64, MSVC Release, Qt 6.9.1 Fusion
local_regression.coverage_note: Focused cases overlap the full core suite; counts are not additive.
local_regression.initial_failures: A GUI locator assumed the old context minimum. It was changed to the stable ModelContextSize identifier; the full GUI suite then passed. Earlier focused regressions and their fixes are covered by the final full core run.

actual_inference.restricted_budget_note: A 4096 MiB reserve on the real 8 GiB device; not an emulation of the older GPU.
actual_inference.benchmark_scope: Application request work reduction. No identical-work kernel gain or universal performance percentage established.
actual_inference.measured_candidate_vs_shipping_binary: Greeting measurements precede final diagnostic parser breadth/RS buffer reporting and GUI test locator updates. The benchmark JSON retains the actual measured hashes; the final shipping binary was additionally exercised below.

packaged_payload.scope: Both archives extracted and all portable payload files match installer bytes; default runtime, core/patch digests, proprietary license, unchanged optional worker, private-output exclusions and fresh-home restricted-PATH CLI checks.

harness_correction: An initial packaged GUI check requested the unshipped Qt offscreen platform and timed out. Retried successfully with the shipped Windows platform and the no-screen diagnostic snapshot; no desktop input was used.
cloud_ci: Recorded separately against the published source commit in the GitHub Actions runs and release validation receipt.
